description: Human-readable name of the KEGG pathway.
Number of genes or KEGG orthologs assigned to the pathway included in enrichment analysis.
Raw enrichment score (ES). Positive values indicate enrichment and negative values indicate depletion.
Enrichment score normalized for pathway size to enable comparisons across pathways.
Nominal p-value associated with the enrichment score.
Estimated false discovery rate associated with pathway enrichment.
Position within the ranked feature list at which the enrichment score reaches maximum deviation from zero.
Summary statistics describing the subset of genes contributing most strongly to pathway enrichment.
KEGG ortholog identifiers comprising the leading-edge subset responsible for enrichment.
